slug: Lokki is a gentle light-keeper spirit, floating with a warm aura as it automates, dims, and balances illumination.
title: Lokki
excerpt: Lokki is a small, overqualified manager of illumination—wrangling up to eight LED channels, four relays, and a handful of motion sensors, gossiping with its fellow Lokki units over LoRa to coordinate the lighting of entire regions, and politely exposing an internet endpoint so you can boss it around from anywhere in the universe.
included: (Optional) Some Motion Sensing modules (Passive Infra Red or Radar)
